product.name: Quick Vault Retriever
product.north_star: Make private local knowledge as fast and dependable to query as a calculator, without turning retrieval into an unbounded agent.
target_users: People with a local JSONL-first knowledge vault
Raycast users who need immediate evidence while staying in their current workflow
Developers integrating a bounded local retrieval primitive
product.promise: Turn a natural-language vault query into inspectable, source-cited evidence in seconds while preserving local ownership and safe abstention.
product.wedge: A read-only Python CLI and Raycast Script Command over a compatible SQLite FTS5 projection.
principles: Retrieval owns evidence; optional models may summarize but never invent or expand authority.
Fast failure is better than a plausible answer from stale or missing evidence.
The query model is general; entity lookup is one use case rather than the architecture.
Private runtime state stays local and public artifacts stay synthetic.
non_goals: Mutating canonical JSONL or human-owned notes
Producing or repairing the SQLite projection
Shipping cloud or local-model synthesis in version 0.1
Optimizing exclusively for contacts, people, or entity properties
assumptions: The caller has a locally accessible compatible SQLite FTS5 projection.
Stable JSONL record IDs are meaningful citations for local use.
A bounded evidence result is useful without conversational synthesis.
The caller can supply a canonical ledger watermark when strict freshness is required.
success_criteria: Warm synthetic p95 retrieval latency is below 1000 ms on the target Mac.
Every successful hit includes a stable record citation.
Missing evidence produces not_found with no fabricated answer.
Fresh-clone setup and make check succeed from documented commands.
No private record, absolute vault path, secret, or generated runtime artifact is tracked.

architecture.system_context: A local read-only retrieval surface between Raycast or a shell and a derived JSONL Vault SQLite projection.
data_flow: An arbitrary natural-language query enters through Raycast or the terminal.
The CLI validates and tokenizes the query without persisting it.
The retriever opens the projection in immutable query-only mode.
Compatibility and optional ledger freshness are checked before FTS retrieval.
Coverage-ranked, bounded snippets leave as a versioned cited evidence packet.
trust_boundaries: Private query and SQLite projection remain local.
Canonical JSONL and its writer are outside process authority.
Public Git contains only source, contracts, documentation, and synthetic fixtures.
Any future model provider is a separate opt-in boundary.
decisions: Use SQLite FTS5 because the canonical vault already produces a local projection.
Use deterministic retrieval before considering model synthesis.
Keep Raycast thin so the CLI contract remains independently testable and portable.
Use local gates instead of GitHub Actions.

design_principles: Show the answer state before controls or implementation detail.
Keep successful output concise enough to scan in Raycast.
Make citations, freshness, ambiguity, and failure states visible.
Prefer a calm text surface over a dashboard for one-shot questions.
engineering_principles: Test behavior through the CLI and evidence-packet contract.
Open data stores with least authority and fail closed on contract drift.
Keep dependencies minimal and use the Python standard library at runtime.
Version public output schemas and preserve stable exit codes.
Measure latency without committing private queries or results.

allowed: Synthetic SQLite fixtures generated during tests
Generic example queries and placeholder runtime paths
forbidden: Real vault records or database copies
Personal names, addresses, private queries, or screenshots
Credentials, tokens, environment files, or key material
Generated reports, caches, and local benchmark corpora

acceptance_scorecard.target: All behavior and contract tests pass
Zero tracked private artifacts or detected secrets
Zero mutation-capable SQLite connections or CLI commands
Fresh-clone setup and validation are documented and executable
Repo-local Go state validates on the exact pinned stack
